{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate rows
duplicate_rows = df.duplicated().sum()

# Check if any patient_id appears more than once
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patient_ids = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

# Print results
duplicate_rows, duplicate_patient_ids"}
